$comment: Findings the smoke harness may report without failing the run.
Every entry must carry a reason and an owner. The harness validates this and fails the run
on a malformed entry, so an accepted finding can never mean 'somebody was in a hurry'.
Matching is deliberately narrow. Use the stable id printed beside every finding in
artifacts/smoke/smoke-report.md - it is derived from the kind, the route and the element,
not from the run, so it survives a reordered crawl and a different device:
A kind-plus-route entry is also allowed, optionally narrowed by a substring of the detail,
for a finding whose element moves between runs:
There is no way to accept a whole kind everywhere. An entry with a kind and neither a route
nor a substring is rejected, because that is a blanket suppression and it is exactly how a
check quietly stops being a check.
